findings.subject: 385936461 .github/workflows/ci.yml :: check [ubuntu-latest]
findings.comparison: Sum of median finish-to-bottleneck idle seconds for parallel jobs at the same dependency level on each observed run; the bottleneck dominates the recorded critical path, not a projected saving.
findings.suggested_fix: Shard the job, give it a larger runner, or split its slowest step.

findings.subject: 385936461 .github/workflows/ci.yml :: check [ubuntu-latest] :: Run make test
findings.comparison: Measured step time above 70% of job duration, only in jobs longer than 10 minutes.
findings.suggested_fix: Split or parallelize the step. If it is a test suite, shard it by package or by historical duration.
